Questions or a tour?

020 – 423 39 30 info@huizefrankendael.nl

Huize Frankendael is an official wedding venue: a unique country estate with a park and formal gardens, in the middle of Amsterdam.

Your entire wedding day can take place with us. The ceremony and reception are held in the 18th-century salons and the garden; dinner and the party that follows take place in the rustic coach house. In good weather we also serve dinner outside in the garden.

Slow Food gastronomy

The catering for your wedding day is provided by restaurant Merkelbach (opens in a new tab). The kitchen’s philosophy matches the stately, historic estate: authentic flavour and Slow Food values are central.

Personal contact

We prepare tailor-made proposals and gladly invite you for a tour and a personal conversation to walk you through the possibilities. We love thinking along about the shape of your wedding day!

Email for a tourCall +31 20 423 39 30

Also see the photo impression of weddings at Huize Frankendael.

Wedding photography

It is not possible to reserve the house for bridal photography alone, and wedding photos can only be taken if your wedding takes place with us. On your own wedding day you are of course free to take photos in and around the house.
